Illinois: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Illinois on the map

Key dates

  • Early voting: September 24, 2026 to November 2, 2026. Early voting begins statewide on September 24. Hours and locations are set by each county or city election authority.
  • Voter registration deadline: October 6, 2026. October 6 is the last day for regular registration and the postmark deadline for mail registration. Online registration closes 2026-10-18. Grace-period registration, including same-day registration, is open from 2026-10-07 through Election Day at designated sites. You need two forms of ID to register in person.
  • Last day to request a mail ballot: October 29, 2026. Mail and online applications must be received by October 29. You can apply in person at your election authority through 2026-11-02. Ballots must be postmarked by 2026-11-03 and received by 2026-11-17.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 6:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.

Official election information: Illinois State Board of Elections

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Governor and Lieutenant Governor

Governor and lieutenant governor are elected together on a joint ticket for a four-year term. Incumbent Governor JB Pritzker is running for a third term. Running mates: Christian Mitchell (Pritzker), Aaron Del Mar (Bailey) and Carolyn Schofield (Corbett).
